title: Predicting Human-Gain Curves under Local Proxy Optimization from Repeated Ratings
abstract: arXiv:2610.41114v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optimizing a proxy objective can improve human-perceived quality, but the resulting gain can vary with optimization strength. Average proxy-human correlation alone does not reveal how human-perceived quality changes as optimization strength increases. We propose PACE (Proxy Alignment and Curvature Expansion), a pre-optimization diagnostic that uses repeated human ratings to predict the human-gain curve induced by a fixed proxy. The method models proxy optimization as a KL-regularized exponential tilt. At KL radius $d$, the local gain is approximated by $A\sqrt{d}+Bd$, where $A$ measures first-order proxy-human alignment and $B$ captures the leading second-order correction along the proxy-optimization path. We estimate $A$ and $B$ from repeated human ratings on calibration items and test the resulting gain-curve prediction on held-out evaluation items. Across SummEval, analysis-eligible WMT MQM clusters, an OpenMEVA-MAGS ROC/WP repeated-r

translated_title: 基于重复评分预测局部代理优化下的人类收益曲线
translated_abstract: 优化代理目标可以提升人类感知的质量，但由此带来的收益会随优化强度的不同而变化。仅凭平均的代理-人类相关性无法揭示人类感知质量如何随优化强度的增加而变化。我们提出PACE（Proxy Alignment and Curvature Expansion，代理对齐与曲率展开），这是一种预优化诊断方法，利用重复的人类评分来预测由固定代理所诱导的人类收益曲线。该方法将代理优化建模为KL正则化的指数倾斜（exponential tilt）。在KL半径 $d$ 处，局部收益近似为 $A\sqrt{d}+Bd$，其中 $A$ 度量一阶的代理-人类对齐程度，$B$ 刻画沿代理优化路径的领头二阶修正项。我们从校准项目上的重复人类评分中估计 $A$ 和 $B$，并在留出的评估项目上测试所得的收益曲线预测。在SummEval、符合条件的WMT MQM聚类、OpenMEVA-MAGS ROC/WP重复评……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出PACE诊断方法，通过重复人类评分在优化前预测固定代理目标在不同优化强度下所能带来的人类感知质量收益曲线。
en_tdlr: PACE is a pre-optimization diagnostic that uses repeated human ratings to predict the human-gain curve induced by a fixed proxy objective across varying optimization strengths.
